mapper.sql: SELECT 'BBS' AS feed_type, b.bbs_id::TEXT AS row_id, b.title, h.hobby_id, h.hobby_nm, b.bbsinfo_id, (SELECT u.nickname FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = b.reg_id) AS reg_nm, (SELECT u.handle FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = b.reg_id) AS reg_handle, (CASE WHEN b.reg_id = #{viewerId} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS mine_yn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_comment c WHERE c.bbs_id = b.bbs_id AND c.use_yn = 'Y')::INTEGER AS comment_cnt, COALESCE(b.good_cnt, 0) AS good_cnt, NULL::VARCHAR AS meet_dt, NULL::VARCHAR AS area_nm, NULL::VARCHAR AS region, NULL::VARCHAR AS status_cd, NULL::VARCHAR AS status_nm, NULL::INTEGER AS capacity, NULL::INTEGER AS accepted_cnt, b.reg_dt AS sort_dt FROM t_bbs b JOIN t_hobby h ON h.bbsinfo_id = b.bbsinfo_id AND h.use_yn = 'Y' JOIN t_user_hobby uh ON uh.hobby_id = h.hobby_id AND uh.use_yn = 'Y' AND uh.user_id = #{viewerId} WHERE b.use_yn = 'Y' AND b.p_bbs_id = 0 AND b.secret_yn = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_user_block ub WHERE ub.user_id = #{viewerId} AND ub.blocked_id = b.reg_id ) UNION ALL SELECT 'RECRUIT' AS feed_type, r.recruit_id::TEXT AS row_id, r.title, h.hobby_id, h.hobby_nm, NULL::INTEGER AS bbsinfo_id, (SELECT u.nickname FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = r.reg_id) AS reg_nm, (SELECT u.handle FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = r.reg_id) AS reg_handle, (CASE WHEN r.reg_id = #{viewerId} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS mine_yn, NULL::INTEGER AS comment_cnt, NULL::INTEGER AS good_cnt, r.meet_dt, (SELECT ac.code_nm FROM t_code ac WHERE ac.code_id = r.area_cd AND ac.p_code_id = 'AREA00') AS area_nm, r.region, r.status_cd, (SELECT sc.code_nm FROM t_code sc WHERE sc.code_id = r.status_cd AND sc.p_code_id = 'RECRUIT00') AS status_nm, r.capacity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit_apply a WHERE a.recruit_id = r.recruit_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.apply_status = 'APPLY02')::INTEGER AS accepted_cnt, r.reg_dt AS sort_dt FROM t_recruit r JOIN t_hobby h ON h.hobby_id = r.hobby_id AND h.use_yn = 'Y' JOIN t_user_hobby uh ON uh.hobby_id = h.hobby_id AND uh.use_yn = 'Y' AND uh.user_id = #{viewerId} WHERE r.use_yn = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_user_block ub WHERE ub.user_id = #{viewerId} AND ub.blocked_id = r.reg_id )
mapper.select: SELECT f.feed_type, f.row_id, f.title, f.hobby_id, f.hobby_nm, f.bbsinfo_id, f.reg_nm, f.reg_handle, f.mine_yn, f.comment_cnt, f.good_cnt, f.meet_dt, f.area_nm, f.region, f.status_cd, f.status_nm, f.capacity, f.accepted_cnt, TO_CHAR(f.sort_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt FROM ( ) f WHERE f.feed_type = #{feedFilter} ORDER BY f.sort_dt DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( ) f WHERE f.feed_type = #{feedFilter}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user_hobby WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND user_id = #{viewerId}
